_method: Across-road scale from known vehicle widths; validated on classes not used for scaling (motorcycle err 0.05 m, bus err 0.16 m). Along-road scale L is NOT determined by vehicle width (verified invariant for L=10..200) and was pinned by assuming ~35 km/h median urban traffic. DIRECTION is immune to that assumption because stretching the along-road axis preserves antiparallelism; SPEED is not, so reported km/h is indicative only.
_limitations: No surveyed ground-control points; not a substitute for site survey.
Recovered vehicle width still correlates with depth (r=0.46), so the perspective is imperfect - accuracy degrades far from the quad.
Camera is labelled PTZ. Measured parked (48/48 samples, <0.1px drift over 993s), but an operator moving it silently invalidates this file. Re-verify before relying on it.
No held-out validation point: 'validation' is deliberately omitted so the loader logs an unverified-accuracy warning rather than passing a check against invented ground truth.
